dog.description_text:
Who has the cutest little underbite you’ve ever seen? Why, Piccolo does! This sweet little guy was adopted 6 years ago and recently returned through no fault of his own. He would love a forever home with a family who will give him a happy life in his golden years…

Piccolo is a 12 1/2 year old Shih Tzu who is as sweet as pie. He is great with everyone including children and dogs! He is up to date on vaccinations, microchipped and neutered and is currently at our Atlas (Queens) location. If you would like to meet this sweetheart, please fill out the adoption application on our website using a laptop or desktop (no phone or tablet, please) at https://bobbiandthestrays.org/adoption-page-new/ .
dog.name: Piccolo
